# Varsha Dental Clinic

> Professional, affordable private dental clinic in Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh, India, led by Dr. Mahendra Verma (BDS). Over a decade of experience in cosmetic, restorative, preventive, pediatric and implant dentistry.

## Dentist

- Dr. Mahendra Verma, BDS — Dental Surgeon, Founder and Lead Dentist
- Focus: minimally invasive procedures, patient comfort, long-term oral health, care for children and anxious patients

## Services

- Digital X-Ray (RVG)
- Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
- Ultrasonic Scaling
- Dentures (Removable Partial Denture and Complete Denture)
- Crowns and Bridges (Capping)
- Post and Core
- Dental Implants
- Smile Designing
- Pyorrhea Treatment
- Oral Rehabilitation
- Teeth Whitening (Bleaching)
- Oral Checkup (Intra-Oral Camera)
- Aesthetic Tooth Jewellery
- Toothache Control
- Sensitivity Control
- Painless Extractions
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Gum Care and Periodontal Treatment

## Promises

- Painless, gentle treatment under local anaesthesia
- Strict hygiene: autoclaved instruments, single-use essentials, hospital-grade sterilisation
- Transparent, fair pricing with full cost estimate shared before any treatment
- Care for children and anxious patients
- Walk-ins welcome during clinic hours
